reviewSummary: Twenty-five attacks run against the D-260 turn 2 draft. The subject is at its expected digest and mode, and it lands the turn 1 dual-OBJECT class cleanly: DR-118 is recited as DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED, matching live file 08, and is not flattened to OPEN. Twenty-four attacks are refuted. One lands. The subject cites the frozen D-260 turn 1 Codex adversarial review at d54d007b…, but those bytes recompute to bfef1752…, and the cited value matches no file in the artifacts directory. Because the Codex review is mode 0444 and predates the turn 2 draft, the digest was already wrong when the subject was authored, so the subject's own remasure-before-adoption clause does not cure it. The miscitation appears twice and serves as the byte-anchor for the very Codex verdict this turn is required to land. One MUST-FIX; no SHOULD-FIX; correction is a two-token recital fix with zero scope effect.
finalDisposition: OBJECT — 1 MUST-FIX (MF-2), 0 SHOULD-FIX. Turn 2 lands D260-MF-1 / MF-1 but introduces a mismatched digest for the frozen turn 1 Codex review.
